# openobserve_dashboard (Data Source)

Reads an existing dashboard, looked up either by `dashboard_id` or by `title`. The full document is returned in `dashboard_json`, which makes this a convenient way to copy a dashboard built in the UI into Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a dashboard built in the UI so its document can be copied into Terraform.
data "openobserve_dashboard" "built_in_ui" {
  title = "Kubernetes Overview"
}

output "dashboard_document" {
  value = data.openobserve_dashboard.built_in_ui.dashboard_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dashboard_id` (String) Dashboard identifier. Supply this or `title`.
- `folder_id` (String) Restrict a title lookup to one folder. All folders are searched when omitted.
- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.
- `title` (String) Dashboard title. Supply this or `dashboard_id`.

### Read-Only

- `dashboard_json` (String) The dashboard document as JSON.
- `description` (String) Dashboard description.
- `hash` (String) Concurrency token from the last write.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{dashboard_id}`.
- `owner` (String) Dashboard owner.
- `role` (String) Role associated with the dashboard.
- `updated_at` (Number) Timestamp of the last modification, in microseconds.
- `version` (Number) Dashboard schema version.
